title: O2 Sensor Heater Control Circuit (Bank 1)
problem: Malfunction in O2 sensor heater control circuit (open/short).
symptoms: Longer time to enter closed loop fuel mode; Poor fuel economy on cold startup; Check engine light
actions: Measure O2 sensor heater coil resistance; Check 12V power supply to heater from relay; Check wiring harness

title: O2 Sensor Heater Control Circuit Low (Bank 1)
problem: O2 sensor heater control circuit voltage is below the minimum limit (short to ground or open circuit).
symptoms: Slight soot on spark plug; Increased tailpipe emissions on cold startup; CEL on
actions: Check for broken wires in O2 sensor connector; Verify ground path; Measure heater resistance

title: O2 Sensor Heater Control Circuit High (Bank 1)
problem: O2 sensor heater control circuit voltage is above the maximum limit (short to 12V).
symptoms: Potential damage to ECU injector/heater driver; Check engine light illuminated
actions: Inspect wiring harness for shorts to power lines; Check O2 heater relay contacts; Replace sensor

title: Manifold Absolute Pressure Circuit Fault
problem: Malfunction detected in the Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) sensor circuit.
symptoms: Rough idle; Poor fuel economy; Misfiring; Check engine light on
actions: Check sensor connector; Clean sensor port; Verify 5V reference voltage; Inspect vacuum lines

title: MAP Sensor Circuit Low Voltage
problem: The MAP sensor voltage signal is below the minimum operational range.
symptoms: Black exhaust smoke; Engine stalling at idle; Weak throttle response
actions: Verify connector pins for corrosion; Test ground circuit; Check MAP sensor resistance; Replace sensor

title: MAP Sensor Circuit High Voltage
problem: The MAP sensor voltage signal is above the maximum operational range.
symptoms: Lean running; Engine stalling under load; Engine surging/RPM hunting
actions: Verify no short to 12V in signal wire; Test sensor output with vacuum pump; Check sensor reference voltage

title: Intake Air Temperature Circuit Fault
problem: Malfunction in the Intake Air Temperature (IAT) sensor circuit.
symptoms: Hesitation on acceleration; Heavy fuel smell; Engine runs rich
actions: Check sensor is plugged in; Clean airbox sensor element; Verify sensor resistance
location: Inside or on top of the airbox

title: IAT Sensor Circuit Low Input (High Temp)
problem: The IAT sensor reporting extremely high temperature or voltage signal shorted to ground.
symptoms: Engine runs too lean when cold; Hesitation; Starting issues
actions: Check wiring harness for short to ground; Measure IAT sensor resistance (cold); Replace IAT sensor
location: Inside or on top of the airbox

title: IAT Sensor Circuit High Input (Low Temp)
problem: The IAT sensor reporting extremely low temperature or circuit open.
symptoms: Engine runs too rich when warm; Spark plug carbon fouling; Increased emissions
actions: Verify connector is firmly clicked in; Test wiring for open circuit; Replace IAT sensor
location: Inside or on top of the airbox

title: Engine Coolant Temp Circuit Malfunction
problem: Malfunction in the Engine Coolant Temperature (ECT) sensor circuit.
symptoms: Radiator fan runs continuously; Engine temp gauge inactive; Hard starting
actions: Verify coolant level; Test ECT sensor resistance (cold vs hot); Check connector pin corrosion
location: Cylinder head or near thermostat housing

title: ECT Sensor Range / Performance Issue
problem: ECT sensor reading remains static or does not correlate with engine run-time temperature increases.
symptoms: Fluctuating dashboard temp readout; Engine runs poorly when warm; Fan runs erratically
actions: Check for thermostat stuck open; Verify ECT resistance sweep under heating; Replace sensor
location: Cylinder head or near thermostat housing

title: ECT Sensor Circuit Low Voltage
problem: ECT sensor reporting extremely high temperature or short to ground.
symptoms: Temperature lamp flashing red; Radiator fan runs immediately upon ignition; Engine running rich
actions: Check harness for short to ground; Measure sensor resistance; Check radiator coolant level
location: Cylinder head or near thermostat housing

title: ECT Sensor Circuit High Voltage
problem: ECT sensor reporting extremely low temperature or open circuit.
symptoms: Temperature lamp stays cold; Radiator fan fails to activate; Hard starting when engine is hot
actions: Verify ECT connector is plugged in; Test sensor resistance; Check wiring for open circuit
location: Cylinder head or near thermostat housing

title: Throttle Position Sensor Circuit Fault
problem: Malfunction in the Throttle Position Sensor (TPS) circuit.
symptoms: Throttle input ignored; Engine stalling; Sudden surges while riding
actions: Verify TPS connector is secure; Verify 5V reference supply; Measure TPS resistance sweep
location: Right side of the throttle body

title: TPS Sensor Circuit Range/Performance Fault
problem: TPS Sensor channel A output is out of normal correlation range with other throttle inputs.
symptoms: Sluggish acceleration; Lack of throttle sensitivity; Check engine light
actions: Clean throttle barrel; Adjust TPS sensor mounting angle; Inspect connector; Replace TPS
location: Right side of the throttle body

title: TPS Sensor Circuit Low Voltage
problem: TPS sensor signal voltage is below the expected closed-throttle limit.
symptoms: Engine hesitates when opening throttle; Stalling; Rough idle
actions: Adjust TPS base position; Clean TPS connector; Test resistance sweep with multimeter; Replace TPS
location: Right side of the throttle body

title: TPS Sensor Circuit High Voltage
problem: TPS sensor signal voltage is above the expected full-throttle limit.
symptoms: High idle speed; Engine surging; Black smoke; Poor fuel economy
actions: Check wiring harness for short to 12V; Test sensor output voltage; Adjust or replace TPS
location: Right side of the throttle body

title: O2 Sensor Circuit Fault
problem: Malfunction in the Oxygen (O2) sensor circuit.
symptoms: Check engine light; High fuel consumption; Rich exhaust smell; Rough idling
actions: Check O2 sensor wiring for burns/rubs on exhaust; Inspect sensor tip for carbon; Replace sensor
location: Exhaust header pipe close to cylinder head

title: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Lean)
problem: O2 sensor signal voltage is stuck low (reporting continuous lean mixture).
symptoms: Engine hesitation; Surging at steady throttle; High exhaust temperature
actions: Check for exhaust leaks near sensor; Clean sensor tip; Test sensor voltage sweep
location: Exhaust header pipe close to cylinder head

title: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Rich)
problem: O2 sensor signal voltage is stuck high (reporting continuous rich mixture).
symptoms: Black smoke; Carbon fouled spark plug; Strong fuel smell; Misfiring
actions: Check for leaking fuel injector; Verify sensor is not oil-contaminated; Replace O2 sensor
location: Exhaust header pipe close to cylinder head

title: O2 Sensor Circuit Slow Response
problem: The oxygen sensor response rate is sluggish during rich-to-lean switches.
symptoms: Flat spots under acceleration; Reduced throttle crispness; Increased emissions
actions: Remove carbon buildup from sensor tip; Inspect for exhaust manifold pinholes; Replace sensor

title: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity Detected
problem: ECU receives zero voltage or no activity from the oxygen sensor.
symptoms: Engine stays in open loop; Poor fuel economy; Lumpy idle when warm
actions: Check for open circuit in O2 sensor signal line; Inspect connector locking tabs; Replace sensor

title: Fuel Injector Circuit Fault - Cylinder 1
problem: Malfunction detected in the fuel injector electrical circuit.
symptoms: Engine cranks but won't start; Spark is present but cylinder remains completely dry
actions: Check injector connector; Measure injector coil resistance (11-16 ohms); Verify ECU pulsing signal
location: Attached to the throttle body runner

title: Fuel Injector Circuit Fault - Cylinder 2
problem: Malfunction in fuel injector 2 circuit (multi-cylinder models).
symptoms: Engine runs on one cylinder; Violent vibrations; Check engine light illuminated
actions: Check injector 2 connector; Test coil resistance (11-16 ohms); Check harness wiring

title: Fuel Injector Circuit Fault - Cylinder 3
problem: Malfunction in fuel injector 3 circuit (multi-cylinder models).
symptoms: Engine misfire; Lost power; Rough sound; Check engine light
actions: Test injector 3 coil resistance; Check electrical harness from ECU; Replace injector

title: Fuel Injector Circuit Fault - Cylinder 4
problem: Malfunction in fuel injector 4 circuit (multi-cylinder models).
symptoms: Engine misfire; Lost power; Engine runs on three cylinders; CEL on
actions: Test injector 4 coil resistance; Verify wiring continuity; Replace injector

title: Engine Overspeed Condition
problem: Engine speed has exceeded the maximum calibrated rev-limit (over-rev).
symptoms: Potential valve train damage; Engine cuts spark/fuel abruptly; Code stored
actions: Check valve clearances; Perform compression test to ensure no bent valves; Check gear shift history

title: Injector Circuit Low Voltage
problem: The fuel injector electrical circuit voltage is lower than the minimum limit.
symptoms: Engine misfires; Sluggish throttle response; Engine cuts out under load
actions: Check injector wiring harness for high resistance; Test battery charge; Clean injector terminal
location: Attached to the throttle body runner

title: Injector Circuit High Voltage
problem: The fuel injector electrical circuit voltage is higher than the maximum limit.
symptoms: Injector stuck open (flooding engine); Heavy black smoke; Engine lock-up risk
actions: Check wiring harness for short to 12V; Test injector valve function; Inspect ECU driver pin
location: Attached to the throttle body runner

title: Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire
problem: Multiple random misfires detected which can cause damage to the catalytic converter.
symptoms: Engine runs extremely rough; Backfiring; Loss of power; Flashing check engine light
actions: Check spark plug gap and wear; Test ignition coil resistance; Verify fuel pressure; Inspect fuel filter

title: Cylinder 1 Misfire Detected
problem: Misfires detected specifically on cylinder 1.
symptoms: Rough idle; Engine vibrating; Loss of compression or ignition
actions: Replace spark plug; Swap ignition coil to verify if fault moves; Check engine compression

title: Cylinder 2 Misfire Detected
problem: Misfires detected specifically on cylinder 2 (multi-cylinder models).
symptoms: Loss of power; Heavy engine shaking; Cylinder 2 exhaust pipe stays cold
actions: Swap spark plug 2; Test coil 2 secondary output; Perform cylinder compression test

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor Circuit Fault
problem: Malfunction in the crankshaft position sensor circuit.
symptoms: Engine cranks but will not start; No spark; Fuel pump primes but no ignition
actions: Test pickup coil resistance (200-400 ohms); Clean stator magnet; Inspect sensor air gap

title: CKP Sensor Range/Performance
problem: Crankshaft sensor signal is erratic or missing pulses.
symptoms: Engine backfires; Starting is difficult; Sudden cut-out at high RPM
actions: Check air gap between pickup coil and rotor (0.5-1.5mm); Verify rotor teeth are clean

title: Ignition Coil 'A' Primary Circuit
problem: Malfunction in the primary control circuit of Ignition Coil A (Cylinder 1).
symptoms: No spark on Cylinder 1; Engine misfires or fails to start; Fuel pump runs
actions: Measure coil 1 primary resistance (0.5-3 ohms); Check 12V supply wire; Replace coil if open

title: Ignition Coil 'B' Primary Circuit
problem: Malfunction in primary control circuit of Ignition Coil B (Cylinder 2).
symptoms: No spark on Cylinder 2; Misfire; Loss of power
actions: Measure coil 2 primary resistance; Verify ECU triggering wire; Replace coil

title: Ignition Coil 'C' Primary Circuit
problem: Malfunction in primary control circuit of Ignition Coil C (Cylinder 3).
symptoms: No spark on Cylinder 3; Loss of power; Misfire
actions: Measure coil 3 primary resistance; Swap coils to test; Check wiring

title: Ignition Coil 'D' Primary Circuit
problem: Malfunction in primary control circuit of Ignition Coil D (Cylinder 4).
symptoms: No spark on Cylinder 4; Loss of power; Misfire; Engine runs on three cylinders
actions: Measure coil 4 primary resistance; Check harness trigger wire; Replace coil

title: EVAP Purge Control Valve Circuit Fault
problem: Malfunction in the Evaporative Emissions (EVAP) purge solenoid valve circuit.
symptoms: Strong petrol fuel smell; Rough idle speed; Engine surging at traffic stops
actions: Check EVAP purge valve connector; Verify solenoid resistance (30-50 ohms); Check for cracked hoses
location: Near throttle body or fuel tank

title: Vehicle Speed Sensor Malfunction
problem: No speed signal received by the ECU.
symptoms: Speedometer displays 0; Speed-dependent features (ABS/TCS) disabled; ABS light on
actions: Clean sensor tip and tone ring of metal dust; Verify air gap; Check wiring harness
location: Rear wheel hub or front fork caliper mount

title: Vehicle Speed Sensor Range/Performance
problem: Speed signal is erratic or drops out under acceleration.
symptoms: Tachometer jumps; Speedometer behaves erratically; ABS light flashes
actions: Inspect speed sensor tone ring alignment; Clean sensor; Verify wiring connector

title: Idle Control System Fault
problem: The Idle Speed Control system is unable to regulate air bypass to maintain target idle.
symptoms: Fluctuating idle speed; Engine stalls when coming to a stop; Low idle when cold
actions: Clean carbon build-up in throttle body and ISC bypass; Check ISC connector; Perform ISC reset

title: System Voltage Low
problem: System operating voltage has dropped below the threshold for reliable operations.
symptoms: Dim lights; Speedometer resets; ABS system disabled; Hard starting
actions: Test battery voltage (12.6V rest
location: 14V running); Check voltage regulator; Inspect stator

title: System Voltage High
problem: System operating voltage is above the safe threshold (overcharging).
symptoms: Lights burn out; Battery swelling or hot; Electronic components failure
actions: Test rectifier output (should not exceed 14.8V); Replace faulty voltage regulator

title: ECU Processor Fault
problem: Internal ECU processor/microcontroller fault detected.
symptoms: Engine won't start; Sudden shutoffs; Complete electrical deadlock; MIL on
actions: Disconnect battery to reset; Verify ground pins; Replace ECU if internal fault persists
location: Under the seat or behind fairing

title: Gear Position Sensor Circuit Malfunction
problem: ECU receives invalid or erratic signal from the gear position switch.
symptoms: Neutral light behaves erratically; Gear indicator on speedometer is blank or incorrect
actions: Clean gear position switch connector; Verify switch contact pin tension; Replace switch
location: Left side crankcase near gear shift shaft

title: Neutral Switch Input Circuit Fault
problem: ECU detects open circuit or failure in neutral safety switch circuit.
symptoms: Engine won't start unless clutch is pulled in; Neutral indicator light out
actions: Check neutral switch continuity; Verify wiring harness connection; Clean switch contacts

title: Inclination Sensor Error (Tilt)
problem: Tilt sensor reports bike is lying down or sensor is loose.
symptoms: Engine cuts out instantly; Fuel pump will not prime; Bike won't restart
actions: Place motorcycle upright; Turn ignition key OFF and then ON; Check sensor mount
location: Under the seat or near the battery

title: ECU Power Supply Circuit Fault
problem: ECU detects unstable or interrupted main power supply voltage.
symptoms: Engine stalling; Instrument cluster resets; Hard starting; Random sensor codes
actions: Check battery terminals for tightness; Verify main fuse; Check ground connections
location: Near battery or main starter relay

title: Start Ability Malfunction
problem: Engine fails to start within the expected number of cranks.
symptoms: Long cranking before starting; Failed start attempts; Rough initial idle
actions: Check fuel pump pressure; Inspect spark plug condition; Verify battery cranking amps

title: Engine RPM Signal Processing Failure
problem: Internal ECU fault in processing the engine RPM signal.
symptoms: Erratic RPM reading on tachometer; Stalling; Fuel cut-off; Rev limiter activates early
actions: Inspect crankshaft sensor wiring; Clean stator area; Check ECU pins

title: Throttle Actuator Control Motor Range
problem: The electronic throttle valve motor range/performance has exceeded limits.
symptoms: Engine enters safety mode; Stalls or high idle; Throttle twist is unresponsive
actions: Verify butterfly valve is clean and moves freely; Check throttle actuator motor connection

title: Throttle Actuator Control Throttle Body Fault
problem: ECU detects mechanical misalignment or stickiness in electronic throttle valves.
symptoms: Limp home mode activated; Stalling at stop; Jerky throttle response
actions: Clean throttle body bore; Check throttle body return spring; Reset ETV calibration

title: TPS Sensor Voltage Correlation Error
problem: ECU detects a voltage mismatch between TPS channel 1 and channel 2 signals.
symptoms: Engine enters limp mode; Severe lack of power; Throttle twist is laggy or dead
actions: Clean throttle body barrel; Recalibrate double TPS settings; Inspect TPS connector
